edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor, defining the privileged account.
transfer uses msg.sender to index and debit balances.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] as the spending allowance.
approveAndCall grants allowance to msg.sender's designated spender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, a caller-identity authorization check.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to owner.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check guarding transferOwnership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check guarding transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership emits OwnershipTransferred with the current owner value.
transferOwnership stores _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
deployGLX sets _totalSupply to the full 1.27B token amount.
deployGLX credits the entire supply to a fixed holder address in balances.
deployGLX flips the deployed flag to block re-initialization.
transfer routes the sender balance deduction through safeSub, whose require guards underflow.
transfer routes the recipient balance increase through safeAdd, whose require guards overflow.
transferFrom deducts the allowance using safeSub, requiring b <= a.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an attacker-supplied spender contract before returning, enabling reentrancy on state (allowed) already written.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary ERC20 contract's transfer, a re-entrant external invocation controllable by the supplied tokenAddress.
Destination address parameter is written into balances in transfer.
Amount parameter drives safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer.
Spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approve.
Tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
From parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
To parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
Tokens parameter is subtracted from balance and from the allowance in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is the allowance key and the target contract of the external call.
Tokens parameter is stored as the allowance in approveAndCall.
Data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval callback.
TokenAddress parameter selects which external contract is invoked.
Tokens parameter is the amount requested from the external ERC20 contract.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transfer reads and updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and updates the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
totalSupply returns _totalSupply less the null-address balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Trivial value parameter of transfer; it has no independent security semantics once folded into the function node.
Amount parameter consumed only by transfer's SafeMath calls; fold into that function node.
Spender address is only meaningful as the allowance key inside approve.
Allowance amount is a plain value stored by approve, with no separate node.
Source address is bound to the balance/allowance updates performed by transferFrom.
Destination address only serves the credit inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives the SafeMath operations of transferFrom and is not a standalone entity.
This parameter is also the callee of the external callback, so it belongs with the unsafe operation node.
Allowance amount written before the external call; merge into the enclosing function node.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the external callback; its security relevance lives in the external call node.
The address selects the untrusted contract being invoked, so it folds into the external call node.
Amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer; merge into the external call node.
Staged owner address only meaningful as the assignment target inside transferOwnership.
